newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dairy reform to be discussed in May.
newsitem.headline: Dairy reform to be discussed in May.

text.p: European Union farm ministers will discuss a detailed report on the dairy industry at an informal council due to be held in May, Dutch minister Jozias van Aartsen said on Tuesday.
A majority at Monday's Farm Council were against dealing with reform of the dairy sector together with the annual farm prices package, he said.
"Italy and the United Kingdom, supported by the Greek and Spanish ministers, presented papers proposing that dairy reform should be dealt with together with prices.
"But, there will be a discussion at the informal council in May and we shall have a detailed report and a market analysis," he told a news conference.
Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler told ministers that his proposal for reform of the dairy sector would be presented later this year, an EU official said.
